newsitem.title: USA: Regulators set Central Hudson hearings.
newsitem.headline: Regulators set Central Hudson hearings.

text.p: The New York State Public Service Commission said Monday it has scheduled a series of open consumer education forums and public statement hearings to seek consumer views on an electric rate and restructuring settlement proposal filed by Central Hudson Gas and Electric Corp.

The commission said hearings are scheduled for 1430 EDT/1830 GMT on May 12 in Newburgh, N.Y., and May 13 in Kingston, N.Y.; and 1930 EDT/2330 GMT May 13 in Poughkeepsie, N.Y. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
